items.title: First Therapy for Advanced Head & Neck Cancer in 10 Years: Johnson & Johnson Secures Accelerated FDA Nod
items.summary: On Thursday, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted accelerated approval to Johnson & Johnson’s (NYSE:JNJ) Rybrevant Faspro as a single agent for adults battling recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HCSCC). Eligible patients include those whose cancer progressed during or following platinum-based chemotherapy and an anti-PD-(L)1 antibody. items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Wins FDA Nod For First Dual Targeted Head And Neck Therapy
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) received FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO in advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The therapy is described as the first dual targeted treatment option for this cancer type and is approved for second line use. RYBREVANT FASPRO now extends beyond its existing lung cancer indication, giving Johnson & Johnson a second major oncology use for the drug.
